property_summary: Rule: Only the contract owner can successfully call withdrawAll to transfer the contract balance (reference enforces msg.sender == owner); the mutant inverts this and allows non-owners, so there exist callers for which the mutant behaves differently (owner can withdraw on reference but mutant rejects owner).
change_summary: Change the visibility guard to require that msg.sender is not the owner, inverting the authorization check so only non-owners can withdraw.
